usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all LDAP authentication realms configured in Proxmox Datacenter Manager — useful before syncing users, auditing realm settings, or verifying that a specific realm (and its bind-dn, server, and mode) is present. Requires the Realm.Allocate privilege on /access/domains; API tokens are supported. The response exposes bind-dn and CA paths in plain text but never the bind password.

examples.summary: List all LDAP realms to verify Active Directory realm is configured with ldaps mode

tips: A realm with 'default: true' is pre-selected on the PDM login screen — check this when users report being sent to the wrong login provider.
The 'mode' field determines TLS behavior: prefer 'ldaps' or 'ldap+starttls' over plain 'ldap' for production. Plain text mode is the default and will appear in responses if TLS was never configured.
sync-attributes maps LDAP fields to PDM user properties (email, firstname, lastname); if these are missing, user sync will create accounts with no display name or contact info.
server2 is an optional fallback; if it is absent and server1 is unreachable, authentication will fail for all users in that realm.
